moment: The Black Pearl / a ghost ship looming out of a moonlit storm; a dotted treasure-map route ending in an X runs along the waterline
why: Tattered black sails, lantern-lit stern windows, fog and storm clouds, plus the dotted route with an X read as pirate-adventure art direction.

moment: A hobby quadcopter hovering outside a concrete and stone college colonnade
why: On its own it is just a drone in front of a brutalist campus; I only lean to the Indian engineering-college world because later frames in the set make that explicit. Low confidence.

moment: The ghost ship fading into dark, with a brass compass and a dashed route of waypoints
why: Same ship as the opening, now darkened, with an octagonal brass compass and a dashed waypoint line: a pirate map or navigation motif.

moment: Golden-hour overlook: an oak in silhouette, a river valley, a horse grazing, the sun setting over mountains
why: Painterly Western vista with a lone horse and hazy amber light looks like an open-world Western screenshot; could also be a generic Western film.

moment: A night camp: canvas tent with a lantern, cooking pot over a campfire, pines and a snowy ridge at dusk
why: Gang-camp composition (wall tent, tripod pot, supply crates, covered wagon edge) is very close to the RDR2 camp.

moment: Drone hovering in a college courtyard beside a concrete colonnade
why: No film signal by itself; the campus architecture is consistent with the classroom frames elsewhere in the set. Low confidence.

moment: Sunset camp by a lake: covered wagon, tethered horses, wall tents, a campfire with a hanging pot
why: Horses, wagon, tents and a stew pot at golden hour is the classic Dutch-gang camp look from RDR2.

moment: The closing scene at Pangong lake: a yellow scooter parked on the pebble shore with mountains behind
why: A yellow Vespa-style scooter on a high-altitude blue lake shore matches the film's ending location; the row of small markers on top looks like a progress or chapter rail.

moment: Floating candles hanging in a starry night sky, as in the Great Hall ceiling
why: Wax candles drifting upright in a star field is a very specific Great Hall signature; the feather-like line looks like a quill.

moment: A folded, hand-inked parchment with a ribbon banner and corridor-like lines, like the Marauder's Map
why: Aged parchment folded in thirds with drawn corridors and compass-rose corners suggests the Marauder's Map; it could equally be a generic treasure map.

moment: A distant tall ship at sunset on a dark sea, plus a treasure-map panel with compass, dashed route, a skull-and-gear marker and an X
why: Skull emblem, compass, dashed route and X plus the lone tall ship on the horizon read as pirate-world UI.

moment: The Black Pearl or Flying Dutchman under a full moon, a brass compass pinned to the frame
why: Ragged black sails, lit stern gallery, moonlit fog and a compass are the cinematic cursed-ship look.

moment: A blood-red dusk over a farmstead with a gnarled oak and fence, with X-shaped target marks floating in the sky
why: Crimson sky over a ranch plus crosshair-style marks recalls RDR2's Dead Eye targeting.

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal: pencil sketches of pines, a lake, a horse with a saddle, a ladder, and a taped-in note
why: Open sketchbook with pencil drawings and taped notes is the RDR2 journal motif.

moment: A dark, candlelit room with a parchment on the floor and glowing ink cracks, like a Marauder's Map unfolding
why: Floating candles and old parchment in a gothic room evoke Hogwarts; the glowing crack pattern is unclear.

moment: A storm sea at night with a glowing teal wave and a lone ship on the horizon; a compass sits at the edge
why: Bioluminescent teal swell, dark storm clouds and a tiny tall ship fit a pirate-sea mood; it could also be Sea of Thieves.

moment: The same night sea, ship on the horizon, compass lower on the screen
why: Same bioluminescent storm sea and tall ship as the previous frame.

moment: Crimson Western farmland at dusk with a drawn route line passing through X-shaped targets and crows overhead
why: The red landscape with a route and crosshair marks looks like Dead Eye or a map path in an RDR2-style world.

moment: A classroom desk with a fine fountain pen in a velvet-lined box next to a pocket stopwatch, with a chalkboard behind
why: Cherished pen and stopwatch on a lecture-hall desk fit the film's dean-and-college props, but there is no unique marker in this frame alone.

moment: A wooden notice wall with nailed-up aged papers and one blank parchment in front, as in a wanted-poster board
why: Tacked-up stained papers on rough planks are a standard Western bounty-board look.

moment: Candles hanging in a starry night sky, as the Great Hall enchanted ceiling
why: Dozens of upright candles suspended against stars and cloud are the Great Hall ceiling.

moment: Hogwarts castle on its cliff above the lake at night, floating candles, a broomstick in the foreground
why: Gothic towers on a crag, reflecting lake, floating candles and a broom are unmistakable.

moment: A chalkboard classroom lit by a sunbeam, a drone drawn in chalk and a row of bars
why: Chalkboard framed in wood with a diagonal beam of light is an Indian engineering classroom look, and consistent with other frames; not unique alone.

moment: The Great Hall: long tables with goblets and plates, floating candles overhead, tall Gothic windows
why: Long house tables, goblets, candles in the air and a high arched window are the Great Hall.

moment: Pangong lake at sunset with the yellow scooter circled and ticked
why: Same yellow scooter on a Himalayan lake shore as the film's closing image.

moment: A night camp: campfire between two canvas tents under a dark mountain skyline, with a few fireflies
why: Dim campfire, tents and fireflies on open grassland match an RDR2 camp at night.

moment: A storm sea with breaking waves above a treasure-map panel: compass, dashed route, a skull-gear marker, an X
why: Same pirate-map UI over a stormy sea.

moment: Great Hall: floating candles above the long tables and the high table
why: Same Great Hall composition.

moment: Golden sunset across a valley with a grazing horse, an oak in silhouette on the left
why: Same vista as the earlier sunset frame; looks like a Western open-world screenshot.

moment: A moonlit harbour at night with masts and lit quay buildings, above a pirate treasure-route panel
why: Tall ships at a lantern-lit port under a moon, plus the compass and skull-gear route, read as Port Royal or Tortuga.

moment: The Marauder's Map: a folded parchment with ink corridors and pairs of footprints walking across
why: Footprints on folded aged parchment with drawn walls is the Marauder's Map.

moment: Arthur's journal page: pencil sketch of mountains, a lake, pines, a saddled horse and birds, with a taped note
why: Same pencil-journal motif, now with more of the landscape sketched.

moment: A field of floating candles in a dark starry space with one candle framed by teal brackets
why: Floating candles again; the teal brackets look like a UI focus marker.

moment: A concrete lecture hall with a chalk drone drawing and the words 'AAL IZZ WELL' on the blackboard
why: The chalk slogan is the film's catchphrase, set in an Indian engineering-college lecture hall.

moment: The Hogwarts Express steaming across the Glenfinnan Viaduct above a Highland loch
why: Scarlet steam locomotive on a curved stone viaduct with a loch is the iconic shot.

moment: The lecture hall again: the chalk drone and 'AAL IZZ WEL...' on the board, benches in the foreground
why: Same slogan and hall.

moment: Close on a classroom desk: a fine pen in a velvet box beside a pocket stopwatch, chalk drone above
why: Same classroom world as the AAL IZZ WELL frames; the props match the dean's pen and stopwatch, but the frame is not unique alone.
